svg.text: Every action renders live data on the touch strip — single or multi-quarter

g.text: Single Quarter — One Slot per Action
Each action gets a single 200×100 encoder slot
Spans 2–4 adjacent encoder slots for a panoramic 52-week view
Spans 2–4 encoder slots for metro-map style git branch diagrams
Turn the encoder to cycle stats, scroll heatmaps, or browse runs
Also scrolls heatmaps, browses workflows, changes range
Tap the touch strip to force a data refresh
Fetches latest data from GitHub immediately
Hold the touch strip to trigger a workflow_dispatch event
Triggers workflow_dispatch on the configured workflow
